request_envelope_size_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: 11257 bytes represents the offline synthetic request envelope calculated by calculate_request_envelope() including synthetic user message and separators. 10939 bytes is the actual byte count transmitted over the wire by Stainless/httpx for chat.completions.create(). Both measurements are accurate for their respective capture boundaries.

historical_gateway_timing_reconciliation.timing_clarification: RCA-2A.10e experienced HTTP 500 timeouts of 186.93s and 108.52s on api.hcnsec.cn. Historical RCA-2A.10b seat 1 failed in ~14.5s. RCA-2A.10g on chat.cordapp.org completed with HTTP 200 in 7.66s.

freeze_boundary_reconciliation.boundary_enforcement: RCA-2A.10g proved gateway transport compatibility for a single request. It did not qualify the model for production or prove long-term reliability. Formal 16-seat A/B comparison in RCA-2A.11 evaluates exploratory guidance effects.
